properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued June 13 at 1:05PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Gulf of America from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon Shoal
out to 5 fathoms...
Hawk Channel from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon Shoal out
to the reef...

At 103 PM EDT, satellite-imagery indicated a developing cumulus
cloud line north of the Lower Keys. This will be conducive to
waterspout formation.
properties.instruction:
Environmental conditions favor waterspout formation. A waterspout
would most likely appear beneath a dark, flat bottom of a building
cumulus line, just at the hint of rain. If you see a waterspout,
stay away, and call in the report to your Florida Keys National
Weather Service, at 3 0 5 2 9 5 1 3 1 6 extension 3.
